When a patient has a medical emergency, the last thing they should worry about is an unexpected medical bill.

Now, thanks to a law I supported, patients are being protected from surprise medical bills. In Congress, I’ll keep working to lower health care costs for Michiganders. https://t.co/UY1qqjcZQI

Open enrollment for health insurance ends Jan. 15!

13.8 million Americans have already signed up. Don’t be left without quality, affordable health care. Visit https://t.co/L2CLGt4qce to sign up or update your existing coverage. https://t.co/hT9o5hA6hB

The spread of the Omicron variant and rising case numbers in Michigan are concerning.

I'm working with state leaders to ensure our hospitals have the resources they need and to expand testing capacity in our communities to help combat this surge.
https://t.co/4SsCYE6jzD

It's outrageous that the price of one Alzheimer's drug increased premiums for every Medicare beneficiary.

While Big Pharma cut the drug cost in half due to public pressure, the Medicare premium increases must be lowered, too.

Medicare should be able to negotiate drug prices. https://t.co/G4FNu1Qmfo

Federal support through the American Rescue Plan is helping Michigan provide economic relief to hospitals and health care heroes.

I applaud @GovWhitmer for supporting Michigan’s economic recovery and getting back to normal.
https://t.co/MMNwiQtCOl

It is unconscionable that Americans pay as high as $1,000 a month for insulin—five to 10 times more than patients in other developed countries.

That’s why I introduced legislation to lower costs for Michiganders with diabetes by capping the price of insulin at $35 per month.

The #AmericanRescuePlan helped to lower the cost of health care premiums, increasing subsidies available to Michiganders to help pay for their health insurance. The average Michigan family saved over $800 dollars a year.

This week, I met with the School Nutrition Association of Michigan. I'm committed to ensuring that every child, regardless of the zip code they live in, has access to healthy school meals. https://t.co/oOrhee0UfO

Supporting our local hospitals is critical to ensuring every patient has access to the health care they need and better serve our community.

That’s why I secured federal funding for @HurleyMedical to help upgrade critical care beds to assist in improving patient care. https://t.co/OhYDD84Nav

12 years ago the Affordable Care Act became law—expanding access to health care & protecting coverage for those with preexisting conditions. Today, thanks to the #AmericanRescuePlan, which I helped pass, MI families are saving on average over $800/year on their health insurance.

The #AffordableCareAct has expanded coverage & lowered health insurance premiums for Michiganders, including those with preexisting conditions.

I support efforts to strengthen the ACA & lower the cost of health insurance premiums and prescription drugs for families and seniors.

My bill is named after Bob von Schwedler, who worked at Delphi for 36 years before losing his pension and benefits. The Health Coverage Tax Credit was critical in helping Bob beat cancer. My bill will restore and increase this critical program to help more people like Bob.

I am proud to announce this federal grant for Head Start programs in Saginaw, which combines education, health care, nutrition and social services to help our children succeed.
https://t.co/41gAkOKBaB

This week I spoke with Flint dialysis patients about my legislation, supported by Republicans and Democrats, to lower health care costs and expand access to tele-health services.

I will continue to fight for affordable, high-quality health care for all Michiganders. https://t.co/0to6x8a0ti

Had a great meeting with the Michigan Chapter of the @MSSociety to discuss what we’re doing in Congress for patients and researchers.
 
As a member of the Congressional MS Caucus, I will continue fighting to lower the cost of prescription drugs and protect Medicaid benefits. https://t.co/gAKsnoKdLj

Telehealth is a critical tool for patients. My legislation expands access to telehealth services for dialysis patients and ensures they won’t face extra fees.

I will keep working so all Michiganders have access to affordable health care.
https://t.co/8C1KIAl5rE

Finding an in-network health care provider shouldn’t be a wild-goose chase.

That’s why I introduced new legislation to increase transparency and ensure patients have access to accurate lists of available health care providers. https://t.co/b2NM4FDdof

I've been working to lower costs for Michiganders, including by passing the #InflationReductionAct, & I'm pleased to see Medicare premiums will decrease next year.

I’ll keep working to lower costs & protect Medicare for the more than 2 million Michigan seniors who rely on it.

Congratulations to @UMFlint School of Nursing! Nurses put themselves in difficult, sometimes dangerous situations to take care of patients.

I passed legislation in the House to set guidelines to ensure our health care workers have a safe work environment.
https://t.co/rIsltD3XFJ

Federal funding I secured helped open a new Great Lakes Bay Health Centers facility in Saginaw!

I’ll continue working in Congress to help mid-Michigan families and seniors get the care they need, regardless of zip code or insurance coverage. https://t.co/C1dsT2WS8h

Every Michigander deserves access to affordable health care—including mental health care.

Earlier this year, I secured federal funding for @GrFlintHealthCo to improve mental health crisis prevention and treatment programs for Michigan veterans, families and seniors. https://t.co/fzK9sl8JK5

Preventing senseless gun violence requires a community effort.

I was proud to secure federal funding to help law enforcement, community/faith leaders, hospitals and public health experts create safer neighborhoods in mid-Michigan.

Learn more: https://t.co/IghL68kcSn https://t.co/ahXBPdjyyG

Now until Dec. 15, you can sign up, renew or change your health insurance plan at https://t.co/L2CLGt4Y1M.

Thanks to legislation I passed, the average family will save $800/year on health insurance premiums & Medicare can negotiate lower drug prices.
https://t.co/dNVAaqR4nb

From protecting the Great Lakes, to advancing mental health care, funding childhood nutrition programs, and supporting our farmers, she has been a leader on so many issues. And throughout our time together in Congress, she has been a trusted legislative partner and friend.

No Michigander should have to struggle to get the mental health care or addiction treatment they need.
 
That’s why I worked to secure federal funding to help New Paths make critical improvements to its facilities and serve more residents. https://t.co/dQ6z9b78MJ
